cohort: 524 pregnant and non-pregnant women attending different clinics of King Khalid University Hospital (KKUH)
finding: The prevalence of C-section delivery among Saudi women attending KKUH was 32.6%, with malpresentation being the most common medical indication (25%).
mod_finding: The study examined the prevalence of cesarean section delivery among Saudi women but did not investigate specific factors influencing the mode of delivery.
